## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change. Link the relevant issue or design note.

## Scope and decisions

Explain important tradeoffs and what is deliberately not included. Identify any change to routes, storage formats, deployment, data sources, or AI behavior.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results. Explicitly list checks not run and why. Add before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, including a narrow viewport.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is focused; unrelated routes, themes, and saved state are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant regression checks pass, or failures and limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Setup, capability, and status documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, or employer/client material are included.
- [ ] Consent, cost, and data boundaries are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Generated output and AI-assisted changes have been reviewed, not accepted blindly.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/Ballzatram/ballzatram/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Development](https://github.com/Ballzatram/ballzatram/blob/master/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). Security-sensitive reports belong in a private channel, not this description.
